letters.subject: Final notice: overdue invoices INV-3051 and INV-3133
letters.body:
Hello Gavin,

This is a final notice about the overdue invoices on your account:

Invoice INV-3051: £1,846.80, due on 30 August 2026, now 67 days overdue
Invoice INV-3133: £1,254.00, due on 30 October 2026, now 6 days overdue

Please pay these within 7 days, and no later than Friday 13 November. If we don't receive payment or hear from you by then, further orders may be put on hold until the account is up to date. If you have already paid, or have a query on either invoice, please let me know straight away.

Kind regards,
Accounts Administrator
Demo Company Ltd
